member.name: T:Regalis.Domain.Entities.Finance.BankTransaction
member.summary: TRN_BankTransaction (document §13–§14). Reconciliation state lives HERE and nowhere else: matching a bank row to a payment or an expense never writes back to TRN_Payment, TRN_Invoice or TRN_Expense, so cash-received keeps exactly one owner. Matching also never creates a payment or expense row — it only points at an existing one, which is the document's explicit no-duplicates rule.

member.name: T:Regalis.Domain.Entities.Finance.Quotation
member.summary: TRN_Quotation — the priced offer that precedes an invoice (document §6). This is where "Draft" lives: a quotation is freely editable while Draft, and the invoice it becomes is immutable from the moment it is issued. Customer, company and tax details are snapshotted when the quotation is sent, so the customer's copy and the resulting invoice agree even if settings or the profile change afterwards.
